lifecycles._note: KMS transit-key CRYPTO lifecycle (C3 Tier-1 fix 2026-06-20; purpose confirmed 2026-06-23). Spine: (1) create RSA-2048 key (asymmetric, for sign/verify/encrypt/decrypt) -> capture key_id; (2) create AES-256-GCM96 key (symmetric, for datakey ONLY) -> soft-capture sym_key_id; (3) create HMAC key (symmetric, for hmac) -> soft-capture hmac_key_id; (4) read-only list-managed-keys -> soft-capture managed_key_id; (5) exercise all crypto ops; (6) teardown all three keys. CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-06-23: purpose purpose-to-operation mapping: rsa-2048->encrypt/decrypt/rewrap/sign/verify; aes256-gcm96->datakey (NOT hmac); hmac->hmac (NOT datakey). Valid advanced key purposes: aes256-gcm96, ecdsa-p256, rsa-2048, aria (KR SOUTH only), hmac. aria returns 400 'g offering scp' error on non-government accounts. All crypto/rotation steps are optional+grouped; a 4xx records coverage and isolates cleanly.

steps.name: list
steps._note: 2026-07-08 DEDUP 이관(owner GO, DEDUP-AUDIT-2026-07-08): security-kms-key 은퇴분 (listkeys).

steps.name: create-sym
steps._note: Creates a symmetric (aes256-gcm96) key for datakey ops. CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-06-23: purpose='aes256-gcm96' supports datakey but NOT hmac (hmac returns 400 scp-security.kms.key-purpose). The hmac operation needs purpose='hmac' (separate create-hmac step below). Valid purpose enums for key_type=advanced: aes256-gcm96, ecdsa-p256, rsa-2048, aria (KR SOUTH gov only), hmac.

steps.name: create-hmac
steps._note: Creates an HMAC key (purpose='hmac') specifically for the hmac operation. CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-06-23: purpose='hmac' creates successfully (201) and the resulting key supports POST /v1/kms/openapi/hmac/{key_id} (200). purpose='aes256-gcm96' does NOT support hmac (returns 400 Key purpose error). Captures hmac_key_id to feed the hmac step below.

steps.name: list-managed-keys
steps._note: Read-only GET: lists managed keys (system-managed, no create). Soft-captures first key id to feed set-managed-key-description below. Account may have 0 managed keys (empty list) — if so managed_key_id stays unresolved and the PUT step still fires against a placeholder (normalizes to * for catalog matching) and 4xx's.

steps.name: datakey
steps._note: datakey requires purpose=aes256-gcm96 key. Routes to sym_key_id captured from create-sym step. CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-06-23: aes256-gcm96 supports datakey (200). hmac-purpose keys do NOT support datakey (400 Key purpose error).

steps.name: hmac
steps._note: HMAC requires purpose=hmac key (NOT aes256-gcm96). Routes to hmac_key_id captured from create-hmac step. CONFIRMED LIVE 2026-06-23: hmac-purpose key supports POST /v1/kms/openapi/hmac/{key_id} (200). aes256-gcm96 key does NOT support hmac (400 Key purpose error).

steps.name: set-managed-key-description
steps._note: updatemanagedkeydescription: managed_key_id soft-captured from list-managed-keys step above. Account has 0 managed keys (GET /v1/managed-kms/transit returned count:0, 2026-06-23) so managed_key_id is unresolved — the path segment stays a placeholder (normalizes to * for catalog matching). Still fires and records the PUT /v1/managed-kms/transit/{key_id}/description endpoint. Permanent blocker: no create API for managed keys (system-managed only).

lifecycles._note: Light, READ-ONLY (no writes, no cleanup). Closes the static id-bound GET gap GET /v1/managed-kms/transit/{key_id} (showmanagedkey) by the list->soft-capture->show idiom. managed-kms keys are SYSTEM-managed: there is NO create in the OpenAPI, so a synthetic id would be a guaranteed-404 dead read — instead we list the caller's managed keys (listmanagedkeys, GET /v1/managed-kms/transit) and soft-capture a REAL key_id from the first item ($.keys[0].id), then show it. A bare account may have system-managed keys (real 2xx) or none (the segment stays a {placeholder} -> normalizes to the catalog '*' key so the GET is still CALLED and the endpoint statically reachable, 4xx-ing harmlessly). Both steps optional with tolerant [200,400,403,404].

steps.name: list-managed-keys
steps._note: listmanagedkeys (zero required params; size/page/sort/name all optional). Soft-captures a REAL managed key_id from the first list item. Drives show-managed-key below.

steps.name: show-managed-key
steps._note: id-bound read (showmanagedkey). Closes GAP-get-id for GET /v1/managed-kms/transit/{key_id}. Keys off the list-captured managed_key_id (a real id when the account has system-managed keys -> 2xx); if none, the segment stays a placeholder (normalizes to catalog '*') and 4xx's.
